jobs: The longbowman slowly draws his bow, holds his aim steady, and looses one single arrow that flies away out of the frame; he lowers the bow with a confident smile. Behind him the other archers stand ready holding their bows, no one else shoots. Blue lion banners ripple gently in the wind, clouds drift. The sky stays clear: no volley, no streaks, no flying arrows in the sky. Gentle, storybook-like motion: keep it a hand-painted illustration with soft brush texture, do not turn it photorealistic. No text on screen.
